claims.claim: LG DirectDrive 7kg washing machine for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows LG branding and “DirectDrive 7Kg” text on the control panel (photo 0).
Witness report reads “DirectDrive 7Kg” on the left side of the control panel (photo 0), not 8kg.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: photos don’t show power-on, heating (if applicable), or a full wash/spin cycle.
risks.proof: Video clip of powering on and running a full wash cycle including spin, showing time progression and no error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: may need repairs).

risks.risk: Rust/oxidation and dirt stains around the lower front edge/door area may indicate corrosion, leaks, or poor maintenance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas plus a clip showing the base area after a short rinse cycle (look for water seepage).
risks.if_unproven: Priced with corrosion/leak risk assumed (worst case: water ingress or parts replacement).

risks.risk: Drum interior condition is unknown (photos only show the door window, not the inside).
risks.proof: Photo through the open door showing the drum interior (front and edges) and rubber seal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially dirty/mildewed or worn seal (worst case: cleaning/seal replacement).

risks.risk: Leak risk and hose/base condition not shown (inlet/outlet hoses, connections, and base).
risks.proof: Photos of inlet hose connection, outlet/drain hose, and underside/base area; then a short test with water running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible leak risk (worst case: hose/connection repair).

risks.risk: Drain pump/filter condition and draining performance not shown.
risks.proof: Video of draining after a wash (water fully clears) and a photo of the drain filter area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible poor draining (worst case: pump/filter service).

risks.risk: Noise/vibration/balancing during spin not shown; scuffs/wear may correlate with worn suspension or bearings.
risks.proof: Video during spin at high speed showing stability and sound level; include a brief vibration check on the floor.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially noisy/unbalanced (worst case: suspension/bearing work).

risks.risk: Exact model number/serial/voltage not readable; compatibility and parts sourcing uncertainty.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/serial/model label (including voltage) and a photo of the power plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without certainty on exact variant/parts (worst case: harder/unknown servicing).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate/model/serial label (voltage and exact model number).
Provide a video of a full wash cycle from start to finish, including spin, with no error codes.
Show close-ups of the rust/oxidation areas and the rubber door seal.
Show inlet/outlet hoses and connections; then a short water test to confirm no leaks.
Show draining performance (video) and, if possible, a photo of the drain filter/pump area.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as an LG DirectDrive 7Kg unit, but operation and internal/maintenance condition are not proven and there is visible rust/wear; price it at the worst case until tested.
